visible_text.text: 7 SIGNS YOUR GUT IS "REGULAR" 💩 from a nutritionist 💩

spoken_content.text: 7 signs your gut is regular from a nutritionist.

I can't tell you how many times I've had clients come to me saying their gut health is so good, they're regular. And then we do a little bit of digging and we find out that there's a lot of work that we have to do.
Number one, you have a bowel movement one to two times every day.
If you have a rare occasion every now and then where you skip a day, like when you're traveling, that's fine.
Number two, it should look like a banana and come out in one solid piece.
Number three, you should barely have to wipe.
Number four, it should sink, not float.
Number five, you should see zero food particles in your bowel movement.
Number six, there should be no oil residue in the toilet.
And number seven, the color should be brown. Anywhere from like a light brown to a darker brown is fine.
Any other color is a no. No gray, white, green, red, yellow, black. No.
